key.name: compact-width
key.summary: Minimum width of the compact notch
key.description: Logical pixels. The notch grows past this if the clock needs more room.

key.name: compact-height
key.description: Logical pixels. 0 matches the top bar height.

key.name: media-activity
key.summary: Show music in the compact notch
key.description: While something plays, show its album art and a visualizer at the notch's edges.

key.name: smooth-visualizer
key.description: Smooth bars redraw every frame while music plays. Off, they step a few times a second, which uses about a fifth of the CPU.

key.name: osd
key.summary: Show volume and brightness in the notch
key.description: Replaces GNOME's on-screen pop-up on the primary monitor. Full-screen apps, which hide the notch, still get GNOME's.

key.name: clipboard
key.description: Copying shows a "Copied to clipboard" notification, which opens the notch. It isn't kept in the notification list, and what was copied is never read.

key.name: notifications
key.description: New notifications open the notch instead of showing a banner. Full-screen apps, which hide the notch, still get GNOME's banners.

key.name: battery
key.summary: Show charging and low battery in the notch

key.name: git
key.summary: Show git commands in the notch
key.description: Push, pull, commit and other commands run in a terminal open the notch with their progress, then how they went. Git has to be pointed at the notch once (trace2.eventTarget, see the preferences).

key.name: collapse-delay
key.summary: Delay before collapsing after the pointer leaves (ms)
